Title: ═══ 1:1 CHAT — MESSAGE SEARCH ═══
Header search button visible and clickable
Description: Verify the search icon is present in the 1:1 chat header and is interactive
Preconditions: User is logged in and a 1:1 chat with George Alan is open
Test Steps:
1. Open a 1:1 chat
2. Locate the Search button in the chat header
3. Verify it is visible
4. Verify it is enabled and clickable
Expected Result: Search button is visible and enabled in the chat header

Title: Click opens search modal with title and initial view
Description: Verify clicking the search button opens the full-screen search modal with correct title and initial state
Test Steps:
1. Click the header Search button
2. Verify search modal opens
3. Verify title reads 'Search Messages'
4. Verify 'Start Your Search' initial view is shown
5. Close the modal
Expected Result: Search modal opens with 'Search Messages' title and initial view visible

Title: All 5 filter tabs are visible
Description: Verify all filter tabs are displayed when search modal is opened
Test Steps:
1. Click header Search button
2. Verify filter tab 'Audio' is visible
3. Verify filter tab 'Documents' is visible
4. Verify filter tab 'Photos' is visible
5. Verify filter tab 'Videos' is visible
6. Verify filter tab 'Links' is visible
7. Close the modal

Title: Typing a known keyword returns matching results
Description: Verify typing a searchable keyword filters and returns at least one matching message
Preconditions: Chat has at least one message containing the keyword
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type a known keyword in the search input
3. Wait for results to render
4. Verify at least 1 result is displayed
5. Verify result subtitle contains the keyword text
6. Close the modal
Expected Result: Results list shows ≥1 message whose subtitle contains the keyword

Title: Search is case-insensitive
Description: Verify searching in uppercase matches messages stored in mixed case
Preconditions: Chat has a message 'Hello World case check'
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type 'HELLO WORLD' (uppercase) in search input
3. Wait for results
4. Verify at least 1 result is displayed
5. Verify result contains 'Hello World' (mixed case)
6. Close the modal
Expected Result: Uppercase keyword matches mixed-case message; case-insensitive

Title: Partial word matching works
Description: Verify a substring of a keyword still returns the full message
Preconditions: Chat has a message with the unique keyword
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type first 7 characters of the keyword
3. Wait for results
4. Verify at least 1 result is displayed
5. Verify result subtitle contains the full keyword
6. Close the modal
Expected Result: Partial keyword returns messages containing the full keyword

Title: Non-existent keyword shows empty state
Description: Verify searching for a keyword with no matches displays the empty state
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type a random non-existent keyword (e.g. 'zzz_xx_nonexistent_99999')
3. Wait for search to resolve
4. Verify 'No Results' empty view is shown
5. Verify empty description contains 'couldn't find'
6. Verify result count is 0
7. Close the modal
Expected Result: 'No Results' empty state is shown with description; 0 results rendered

Title: Clear button resets input and returns to initial view
Description: Verify the clear button empties the input and restores the initial view
Preconditions: Search modal has results from a typed keyword
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type a keyword to trigger results
3. Verify results appear
4. Verify clear button is visible
5. Click the clear button
6. Verify input value is empty
7. Verify 'Start Your Search' initial view is shown
8. Close the modal
Expected Result: Input becomes empty and initial view is restored

Title: Filter tabs filter results correctly for text-only chat
Description: Verify each filter tab shows empty state when the chat has only text messages
Preconditions: Chat has only text messages matching the keyword
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type the known keyword
3. Verify at least 1 result appears
4. Click 'Audio' filter — verify empty state
5. Reopen search and repeat for 'Documents' — verify empty
6. Reopen search and repeat for 'Photos' — verify empty
7. Reopen search and repeat for 'Videos' — verify empty
8. Reopen search and repeat for 'Links' — verify empty
Expected Result: Each media filter shows empty state since chat contains only text
Comments: UIKit hides sibling filters once one is selected — modal is reopened per filter

Title: Typing then manually clearing restores initial view
Description: Verify manually emptying the input (without clear button) returns initial view
Preconditions: Search modal is open with results
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type the known keyword
3. Verify results appear
4. Manually clear the input via keyboard (fill with '')
5. Wait for state update
6. Verify 'Start Your Search' initial view is restored
7. Close the modal
Expected Result: Manual clearing of input restores the initial view

Title: Close button hides search modal
Description: Verify clicking the close button exits the search and returns to the chat
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Verify close button is visible
3. Click the close button
4. Verify search modal is no longer visible
5. Verify message composer is visible and interactive
Expected Result: Search modal closes and chat composer is back

Title: Empty keyword shows initial view not empty state
Description: Verify opening search with no input shows initial view rather than empty results
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Verify input is empty
3. Verify 'Start Your Search' initial view is shown
4. Verify 'No Results' empty view is NOT shown
5. Close the modal
Expected Result: Initial view is shown; empty state is NOT shown when input is empty

Title: ═══ GROUP CHAT — MESSAGE SEARCH ═══
Group chat search button opens modal
Description: Verify the search button is present in a group chat and opens the search modal
Preconditions: User is in a freshly created group chat
Test Steps:
1. Open a group chat
2. Verify search button is visible in the header
3. Click the search button
4. Verify search modal opens
5. Verify 'Start Your Search' initial view is shown
6. Close the modal
Expected Result: Search modal opens in group chat with initial view

Title: Keyword match in group returns results
Description: Verify a known keyword in a group chat returns matching messages
Preconditions: Group chat has messages containing a unique keyword
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal in group chat
2. Type the group keyword
3. Wait for search indexing (retry up to 30s)
4. Verify at least 1 result is displayed
5. Verify result subtitle contains the keyword
6. Close the modal
Expected Result: Group search returns messages matching the keyword
Comments: Retries are built-in because group indexing is async

Title: Non-existent keyword in group shows empty state
Description: Verify non-existent keyword in group chat triggers empty state
Preconditions: User is in a group chat
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type a random non-existent keyword (e.g. 'zzz_group_nonexistent_99999')
3. Wait for search to resolve
4. Verify 'No Results' empty state is shown
5. Verify result count is 0
6. Close the modal
Expected Result: 'No Results' empty state is shown; 0 results rendered
Comments: Occasionally flaky on fresh groups due to backend index delay

Title: Clear button resets group search
Description: Verify the clear button works correctly in group chat search
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal in group
2. Type the group keyword
3. Verify results appear
4. Click the clear button
5. Verify input is empty
6. Verify initial view is restored
7. Close the modal
Expected Result: Input is cleared and initial view is shown

Title: Filter tabs work in group search
Description: Verify each filter tab functions in group chat search
Preconditions: Group chat has only text messages
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal
2. Type the group keyword
3. Verify text results appear
4. Click 'Audio' filter — verify empty
5. Reopen and repeat for 'Documents' — verify empty
6. Reopen and repeat for 'Photos' — verify empty
7. Reopen and repeat for 'Videos' — verify empty
8. Reopen and repeat for 'Links' — verify empty
Expected Result: Each filter returns empty state for text-only group

Title: Close button exits group search
Description: Verify the close button works in group chat search and returns to the chat
Preconditions: Group chat search modal is open
Test Steps:
1. Open search modal in group
2. Click the close button
3. Verify search modal is hidden
4. Verify group chat composer is visible
Expected Result: Search modal closes and group chat composer is visible
